description: Per-pass predicted-class churn of the edge-injection feedback mechanism, trained-head consultant, real advice. Churn is measured between consecutive loop passes, so it is the injection path's own footprint and does not include output fusion. Source traces: tmp/multiseed_v2/head/<dataset>_seed<seed>/feedback_trace_real.json

contrast.note: The attention-bias variant produces churn of exactly 0.0000. The edge-injection mechanism does not. The two must not be quoted interchangeably.

unsw_nb15.flip_note: Summed over folds and iterations; an edge that changes class twice is counted twice. Direction only, not a clean per-edge count.

ton_iot.flip_note: Summed over folds and iterations; an edge that changes class twice is counted twice. Direction only, not a clean per-edge count.
